title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 6a9e31305898… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 6a9e31305898a3bee036b222aa9d3f3034c12b718eefd7a79b4644633fce443d was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-16. This file was seen three times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. The file hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool that was staged or delivered during the attack. Organizations are advised to match this hash against files in their environments and security feeds.
